about.title: A Little About Me
about.imageAlt: Mehedi Hasan sitting on a motorcycle on a city street
about.caption: Mehedi Hasan · Web Developer
paragraphs: This is  **Mehedi Hasan**, a web developer who enjoys the moment a design stops being a static picture and becomes something people can actually use. For the past **5–6 years**, that has been my work — building websites and web applications that are fast, responsive and easy to use.

My focus is turning UI/UX designs into clean, reusable and maintainable frontend code with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and Tailwind CSS — and building and customising sites on CMS platforms like WordPress and Wix. I care about the details that make an interface feel right: consistent spacing, smooth interactions, accessible markup and layouts that hold up on every screen size.
The web keeps moving, so I keep learning — exploring new tools, patterns and techniques that help me build better experiences.
